rounds.notes:
### **| Round 1 |**

- [Sköldkastning](item_a6c36dee-d961-428b-b27c-93ba5ef377d8)

 Top 3 powers in the game, great burst damage, great for proccing effects late game, pierces 

From rounds 1-3 we'll be playing a little more passive than we will later, play to poke with skoeldkastning unless you see an opportunity to kill someone and survive it! Don't int or go for a trade, you're more valuable than anyone you can kill. 

#### **Items** 

- [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418)
- [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295)

rounds.notes:
### **| Round 2 |**

We're now just farming rallies, until we get more items, I've found you can use rally both how its supposed to be used traditionally and also as almost a pulse bomb (?) to take 1 person out of the fight instantly, however its important to note when using rally that way, you should perform the normal combo first and use rally as a 2nd bash. 

#### **Items** 

- [Scavenged Steel](item_fb9d2d13-db05-46fa-b3c6-07495b1872a4)

If you cannot afford Steel this round, sell items in this order to afford it 

[Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) -> [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) ->[Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) ->

rounds.notes:
### **| Round 3 |** 

It's important to note, if the enemy tank is winston, and he's diving your backline, please for the love of god walk into his bubble and rock his world!!! Your shield throw will bounce off his shield for faster burst damage and you'll be able to to atleast scare him off whoever he dove. 

We have a few power options here; 

- [Mender Bender](item_df95cea8-7040-4bfc-9145-8b820edce5a3)

For survival + more [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0) procs round 5 

- [God Ray](item_4abb5cdb-f113-4f21-aa0a-e67d95a11fd0)

For more damage, good against unshielded tanks such as Orisa, D.va, or Junkerqueen. 

- [Lindholm Wall](item_a733a6f5-72cd-43cd-a0fd-b1e03fa34753)

Good if the enemies are grouping but you can't hit them with shields consistently (such as D.vas who do actually eat shields.), allows you to hit multiple people with the bash for more [Scavenged Steel](item_fb9d2d13-db05-46fa-b3c6-07495b1872a4) procs. 
 
#### **Items**

- [Dragons' Incinerator](item_d0794681-844b-4ce8-9857-15320f35a634) [Optional]

Good if the enemy is building bulk, especially the tank

- [Omni-Boots](item_632bd990-4523-4b3f-b08a-6dd11280c6f9) [Optional] 

Good for closing the distance on long range enemies ( 1m0 to 14m bash )

- [Squire's Satchel](item_b530e529-3bf4-4b7c-abe8-6e976a5c35bf) [Optional]

Good for enemies who bypass shields (AP JQ, Winston, Etc.) 

- [Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f) [Optional]

Very niche item, lets you counter pin rein/brig and get up faster for a shield throw, also lets you play more aggressive into Ana.

rounds.notes:
### **| Round 4 |** 

Here we'll buy [Omni-Boots](item_632bd990-4523-4b3f-b08a-6dd11280c6f9) just for its increased mobility, despite being advertised as wp its secretly another ap item. The reason we should be grabbing it almost every game is its just so good for escaping or engaging, you can all but teleport onto a dps and take them out of a fight with rally, the same for squishy supports. 

#### **Items** 

- [Omni-Boots](item_632bd990-4523-4b3f-b08a-6dd11280c6f9)

As stated above, great mobility. 

- [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) [Optional]

For when you have a support who cannot or will not run debuffs ( Wp Moira, Mercy, Wp Juno, etc )

- [Divine Intervention](item_b5148b7f-8529-4b1b-a90c-5d7cf13f8f0c) [Optional]

Super strong item for bulky brig builds, lets you brawl with the enemy tank especially later when you get [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0) and more items. 

- [Dragons' Incinerator](item_d0794681-844b-4ce8-9857-15320f35a634) [Optional]

Still a good choice as its great for melting high hp tanks & the 2 seconds on rally can mean killing someone or not.

### | **Round 5 |**

- [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0)

Super strong with Skoeldkastning for alot of overhealth, which enables more aggressive play. From here on out we can be pretty mean and take fights with people you normally wouldn't. 

#### **Items**

- [Dragons' Incinerator](item_d0794681-844b-4ce8-9857-15320f35a634)

As said previously, good for melting bulky tanks, good general item for longer rally, just a good global item, there are better niche choices but those are for specific matchups.

From here on you only get stronger, brig scales very well the later the game goes, and you really shouldn't lose any late game rounds.

#### **Items**

rounds.notes:
### **| Round 7 |**

- [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee)

We use this for the inspire procs every 1.5 seconds in rally and the 25% shorter cooldowns, very strong rallies which you should get consistently at this point in the game, rally should be a cooldown rather than an ult for you. 

#### **Items** 

Literally any of the previously mentioned purples, build bulk or damage, you could keep omni/cushioned this late if you really want to.
